days.title: What Is Philosophy?
days.focus: From mythos to logos; why ancient Greece (Miletus, trade, leisure, debate); the main branches (metaphysics, epistemology, ethics, logic, aesthetics, political philosophy); how this course works

days.title: The Milesians: Thales, Anaximander, Anaximenes
days.focus: The search for the arche (first principle); water, the apeiron, air; naturalistic explanation; first scientific thinking

days.title: Pythagoras: Number, Harmony and the Soul
days.focus: Pythagorean community, number as reality, musical harmony, transmigration of souls, mathematics as the language of nature

days.title: Heraclitus: Flux and Logos
days.focus: Everything flows, the river fragment, unity of opposites, fire, the logos

days.title: Parmenides and Zeno: Being and Paradox
days.focus: Way of Truth vs Way of Opinion, what-is cannot not be, change as illusion, Zeno's paradoxes (Achilles, dichotomy, arrow), reason vs senses

days.title: The Pluralists: Empedocles and Anaxagoras
days.focus: Four roots, Love and Strife, Anaxagoras' nous (Mind), reconciling change with Parmenides

days.title: The Atomists: Leucippus and Democritus
days.focus: Atoms and void, mechanism, primary vs secondary qualities preview, cheerfulness ethics

days.title: The Sophists: Rhetoric, Relativism and Persuasion
days.focus: Protagoras ('man is the measure'), Gorgias, nomos vs physis, paid teachers of persuasion in Athenian democracy

days.title: Socrates and the Examined Life
days.focus: The Socratic method (elenchus), irony, 'I know that I know nothing', the oracle, virtue as knowledge

days.title: The Trial and Death of Socrates
days.focus: Apology, Crito, Phaedo death scene; civil disobedience, obedience to law, integrity

days.title: Plato's Theory of Forms
days.focus: Forms vs particulars, two worlds, the Form of the Good, recollection (Meno), problems (Third Man)

days.title: The Cave and the Divided Line: Plato on Knowledge
days.focus: Allegory of the Cave, Divided Line, knowledge vs opinion, education as turning the soul

days.title: The Republic I: Justice and the Tripartite Soul
days.focus: Thrasymachus, Ring of Gyges, reason/spirit/appetite, justice as harmony

days.title: The Republic II: Philosopher-Kings and the Critique of Democracy
days.focus: The ideal city, guardians, noble lie, ship of state, decline of regimes, Plato's critique of democracy

days.title: Love, Beauty and Immortality: Symposium and Phaedo
days.focus: Diotima's ladder of love, Aristophanes' myth, arguments for immortality of the soul

days.title: Aristotle: The Student Who Disagreed
days.focus: Life, Academy to Lyceum, tutor of Alexander, empiricist turn, critique of the Forms

days.title: Logic: The Syllogism and the Laws of Thought
days.focus: Categorical syllogism, validity vs truth, non-contradiction, excluded middle, deduction vs induction

days.title: Metaphysics: Substance, Form, Matter and the Four Causes
days.focus: Substance, hylomorphism, potentiality/actuality, the four causes, the unmoved mover

days.title: Nature, Purpose and the Soul
days.focus: Teleology, biology, De Anima: nutritive, sensitive, rational soul

days.title: Ethics: Happiness, Virtue and the Golden Mean
days.focus: Eudaimonia, function argument, virtue as habit, golden mean, practical wisdom (phronesis), friendship

days.title: Politics and Poetics: The Political Animal and the Power of Tragedy
days.focus: Humans as political animals, constitutions, slavery critique, Poetics: mimesis, catharsis, tragic flaw

days.title: Review: The Greek Foundations
days.focus: REVIEW DAY covering Days 1-21; synthesis, comparison table, cumulative quiz

days.title: The Cynics: Diogenes and Life Against Convention
days.focus: Antisthenes, Diogenes, living by nature, shamelessness, cosmopolitanism

days.title: Epicurus: Pleasure, Friendship and Freedom from Fear
days.focus: Ataraxia, kinds of desires, death is nothing to us, the Garden, Lucretius, the swerve

days.title: Early Stoicism: Living According to Nature
days.focus: Zeno of Citium, Chrysippus, logos, virtue as the only good, indifferents, passions

days.title: Roman Stoicism: Seneca, Epictetus and Marcus Aurelius
days.focus: Dichotomy of control, premeditatio malorum, Meditations, modern CBT roots

days.title: The Skeptics: Suspending Judgment
days.focus: Pyrrho, Academic skepticism (Arcesilaus, Carneades), Sextus Empiricus, the modes, epoche and tranquility

days.title: Plotinus and Neoplatonism
days.focus: The One, emanation, Intellect, Soul, ascent, influence on Christianity and Islam

days.title: Review: Philosophy as a Way of Life
days.focus: REVIEW DAY covering Days 23-28 (and links back to Greek foundations); compare the schools' recipes for a good life

days.title: Augustine I: Restless Hearts, Evil and Free Will
days.focus: Confessions, faith seeking understanding, evil as privation, free will defense

days.title: Augustine II and Boethius: Time, Two Cities and Consolation
days.focus: Augustine on time, City of God, Boethius' Consolation of Philosophy, Lady Philosophy, wheel of fortune, divine foreknowledge

days.title: The Islamic Golden Age: al-Kindi, al-Farabi and Avicenna
days.focus: House of Wisdom translation movement, al-Farabi's virtuous city, Avicenna's floating man and essence/existence, necessary being

days.title: Al-Ghazali, Averroes and Maimonides: Debates on Faith and Reason
days.focus: Incoherence of the Philosophers, causation critique, Averroes' reply, Maimonides' Guide for the Perplexed, negative theology

days.title: Anselm, Abelard and the Problem of Universals
days.focus: Ontological argument, Gaunilo's reply, scholastic method, realism vs nominalism vs conceptualism

days.title: Thomas Aquinas I: The Five Ways
days.focus: Synthesis of Aristotle and Christianity, the five ways, faith and reason as compatible

days.title: Aquinas II and William of Ockham: Natural Law and the Razor
days.focus: Natural law, double effect, just war, Ockham's razor, nominalism, seeds of modernity

days.title: Review: Medieval Philosophy
days.focus: REVIEW DAY covering Days 30-36

units.title: Renaissance and the Birth of the Modern

days.title: Renaissance Humanism: Pico, Erasmus and Human Dignity
days.focus: Return to the sources, Oration on the Dignity of Man, Erasmus, Thomas More's Utopia

days.title: Machiavelli: Power Without Illusions
days.focus: The Prince, virtu and fortuna, better feared than loved, Discourses on Livy, realism in politics

days.title: Montaigne and the Return of Doubt
days.focus: The essay form, 'What do I know?', cultural relativism (On Cannibals), self-examination

days.title: Bacon, Galileo and the Scientific Revolution
days.focus: Copernicus, Galileo, Novum Organum, idols of the mind, induction, knowledge is power

days.title: Hobbes: The State of Nature and the Leviathan
days.focus: Materialism, state of nature, 'nasty, brutish and short', social contract, sovereign

days.title: Descartes I: Radical Doubt and 'I Think, Therefore I Am'
days.focus: Method of doubt, dream argument, evil demon, cogito, clear and distinct ideas

days.title: Descartes II: God, Mind and Body
days.focus: Trademark argument, Cartesian circle, mind-body dualism, Elisabeth of Bohemia's interaction problem, pineal gland

days.title: Spinoza: God or Nature
days.focus: Ethics in geometrical order, one substance, Deus sive Natura, determinism, freedom as understanding, excommunication

days.title: Leibniz: Monads and the Best of All Possible Worlds
days.focus: Monads, pre-established harmony, principle of sufficient reason, identity of indiscernibles, theodicy, Voltaire's Candide satire

days.title: Locke I: The Blank Slate and the Origin of Ideas
days.focus: Tabula rasa, against innate ideas, simple/complex ideas, primary/secondary qualities, personal identity and memory

days.title: Berkeley: To Be Is to Be Perceived
days.focus: Immaterialism, esse est percipi, attack on matter, tree in the quad, God as perceiver

days.title: Hume I: Impressions, Causation and the Problem of Induction
days.focus: Impressions and ideas, copy principle, Hume's fork, causation as constant conjunction, problem of induction

days.title: Hume II: The Self, Morality and Religion
days.focus: Bundle theory, reason is slave of the passions, is-ought gap, Dialogues on Natural Religion, miracles

days.title: Review: Rationalists vs. Empiricists
days.focus: REVIEW DAY covering Days 38-50

days.title: Locke II: Natural Rights and Government by Consent
days.focus: Second Treatise, life/liberty/property, labor theory of property, right of revolution, toleration, influence on Declaration of Independence

days.title: Rousseau: The Social Contract and the General Will
days.focus: Noble savage myth vs actual view, amour-propre, 'born free yet everywhere in chains', general will, Emile

days.title: Voltaire, Wollstonecraft and the Enlightenment's Expanding Circle
days.focus: Voltaire on tolerance, Diderot's Encyclopedia, Adam Smith's moral sentiments, Wollstonecraft's Vindication of the Rights of Woman

days.title: Kant I: The Copernican Revolution in Philosophy
days.focus: Waking from dogmatic slumber, synthetic a priori, categories, phenomena vs noumena

days.title: Kant II: The Categorical Imperative
days.focus: Good will, duty, hypothetical vs categorical imperatives, universal law formula, humanity formula, lying to the murderer

days.title: Kant III: Enlightenment, Peace and the Sublime
days.focus: 'What is Enlightenment?' (sapere aude), Perpetual Peace, Critique of Judgment, beauty and the sublime

days.title: Review: The Age of Reason
days.focus: REVIEW DAY covering Days 52-57

days.title: Hegel: Dialectic, History and Spirit
days.focus: Dialectic (and the thesis-antithesis-synthesis myth), Geist, master-slave dialectic, history as progress of freedom, owl of Minerva

days.title: Schopenhauer: The World as Will
days.focus: Will and representation, pessimism, art and compassion as escape, influence on Eastern-Western dialogue

days.title: Bentham and Mill: Utilitarianism
days.focus: Greatest happiness principle, hedonic calculus, Mill's higher and lower pleasures, consequentialism, objections

days.title: Mill: On Liberty and the Subjection of Women
days.focus: Harm principle, free speech, tyranny of the majority, Harriet Taylor Mill, equality of the sexes

days.title: Marx: Alienation, Class and History
days.focus: Historical materialism, alienated labor, class struggle, base and superstructure, critique of capitalism, legacy and failures

days.title: Kierkegaard: Faith, Anxiety and the Individual
days.focus: Three stages (aesthetic, ethical, religious), leap of faith, Abraham, anxiety, subjectivity is truth

days.title: Nietzsche I: The Death of God and the Genealogy of Morals
days.focus: God is dead, master and slave morality, ressentiment, perspectivism

days.title: Nietzsche II: Will to Power, the Übermensch and Eternal Recurrence
days.focus: Will to power, Übermensch, eternal recurrence, amor fati, misuse by Nazis

days.title: American Pragmatism: Peirce, James and Dewey
days.focus: Transcendentalist background (Emerson, Thoreau), pragmatic maxim, James' will to believe, Dewey on democracy and education

days.title: Review: The Nineteenth Century
days.focus: REVIEW DAY covering Days 59-67

days.title: Frege and Russell: The Logic Revolution
days.focus: Modern logic, sense and reference, Russell's theory of descriptions, Russell's paradox, analysis as method

days.title: Early Wittgenstein: The Limits of Language
days.focus: Tractatus, picture theory, what can be shown vs said, 'whereof one cannot speak'

days.title: Logical Positivism and the Verification Principle
days.focus: Vienna Circle, A.J. Ayer, verification principle, emotivism, self-refutation problem

days.title: Popper and Kuhn: What Makes Science Science?
days.focus: Falsification, demarcation, Kuhn's paradigms and revolutions, normal science

days.title: Later Wittgenstein and Ordinary Language
days.focus: Philosophical Investigations, language games, meaning as use, family resemblance, private language, J.L. Austin speech acts

days.title: Quine, Gettier and the Puzzle of Knowledge
days.focus: Justified true belief, Gettier cases, Two Dogmas of Empiricism, web of belief, naturalized epistemology

days.title: Husserl and Phenomenology
days.focus: Back to the things themselves, intentionality, bracketing (epoche), lived experience

days.title: Heidegger: Being and Time
days.focus: Question of Being, Dasein, being-in-the-world, the they (das Man), authenticity, being-toward-death, the Nazi problem

days.title: Sartre: Existence Precedes Essence
days.focus: Radical freedom, bad faith (the waiter), anguish, 'hell is other people', responsibility

days.title: Simone de Beauvoir: The Second Sex and the Ethics of Ambiguity
days.focus: 'One is not born, but becomes, a woman', the Other, ambiguity, freedom requires the freedom of others

days.title: Camus and the Absurd
days.focus: The absurd, Myth of Sisyphus, philosophical suicide, revolt, The Stranger, The Rebel

days.title: The Frankfurt School and Hannah Arendt
days.focus: Critical theory, culture industry, Habermas' public sphere, Arendt on totalitarianism and the banality of evil

days.title: Structuralism and Postmodernism: Foucault, Derrida and Lyotard
days.focus: Saussure, power/knowledge, the panopticon, deconstruction, incredulity toward metanarratives, criticisms

days.title: Rawls and Nozick: Justice in Modern Society
days.focus: Original position, veil of ignorance, difference principle, Nozick's entitlement theory, Wilt Chamberlain argument, experience machine

days.title: Applied Ethics: Singer, Trolleys and Bioethics
days.focus: Drowning child, animal liberation, trolley problem (Foot, Thomson), Thomson's violinist, bioethics principles

days.title: Philosophy of Mind: Machines, Bats and the Hard Problem
days.focus: Behaviorism, identity theory, functionalism, Turing test, Chinese Room, Nagel's bat, Mary's room, Chalmers' hard problem

days.title: The Return of Virtue and the Ethics of Care
days.focus: Anscombe's 'Modern Moral Philosophy', MacIntyre's After Virtue, Foot, Gilligan and Noddings on care ethics

days.title: Voices from the Margins: Race, Gender and Decolonial Thought
days.focus: Du Bois' double consciousness, Fanon, feminist epistemology, standpoint theory, Kwame Anthony Appiah, epistemic injustice (Fricker)

days.title: Philosophy in Global Dialogue
days.focus: Confucius, Laozi, the Buddha, Nagarjuna, Ubuntu; parallels and contrasts with Greek philosophy encountered earlier

days.title: Environmental Ethics and Obligations to the Future
days.focus: Leopold's land ethic, Naess' deep ecology, climate ethics, Parfit's non-identity problem, longtermism and its critics

days.title: Philosophy of Technology and Artificial Intelligence
days.focus: Can machines think revisited, AI ethics, algorithmic bias, privacy, attention economy, personhood, the alignment problem

days.title: Final Synthesis: The Great Conversation and Your Philosophy
days.focus: FINAL REVIEW: tour of 2,600 years, recurring questions, building your own worldview, how to keep learning

tracks.title: Logic and Critical Thinking
tracks.description: Formal tools for clear reasoning, from truth tables to paradoxes.

lessons.title: Propositional Logic and Truth Tables
lessons.focus: Connectives, truth tables, validity, modus ponens/tollens, common formal fallacies (affirming the consequent)

lessons.title: Predicate Logic and Quantifiers
lessons.focus: All/some, quantifier scope, translating English into logic, why Frege's logic beat Aristotle's

lessons.title: Informal Fallacies in the Wild
lessons.focus: Ad hominem, straw man, slippery slope, false dilemma, appeal to authority, motivated reasoning, steelmanning

lessons.title: Modal Logic and Possible Worlds
lessons.focus: Necessity and possibility, possible worlds semantics (Kripke, Lewis), counterfactuals

lessons.title: Paradoxes: Liars, Heaps and Incompleteness
lessons.focus: Liar paradox, sorites, Russell's paradox revisited, Gödel's incompleteness in plain language

tracks.title: Ethics and Metaethics
tracks.description: What, if anything, makes morality true?

lessons.title: Moral Realism and Its Rivals
lessons.focus: Realism, error theory (Mackie), relativism, the argument from disagreement and queerness

lessons.title: Expressivism and the Meaning of 'Good'
lessons.focus: Moore's open question argument, emotivism, Blackburn's quasi-realism, Frege-Geach problem

lessons.title: Moral Luck and Responsibility
lessons.focus: Williams and Nagel, kinds of moral luck, Strawson's reactive attitudes

lessons.title: Contractualism: What We Owe to Each Other
lessons.focus: Scanlon, reasonable rejection, Gauthier, comparison with utilitarianism and Kant

lessons.title: Population Ethics and Effective Altruism
lessons.focus: Parfit's repugnant conclusion, non-identity problem, effective altruism, demandingness objection

tracks.title: Mind, Self and Free Will
tracks.description: Consciousness, personal identity and whether we are free.

lessons.title: Functionalism and the Computational Mind
lessons.focus: Multiple realizability, Putnam, Fodor, inverted spectrum, absent qualia

lessons.title: Personal Identity: What Makes You You?
lessons.focus: Locke revisited, ship of Theseus, teleportation and fission cases, Parfit's 'identity is not what matters'

lessons.title: Free Will and Determinism
lessons.focus: Hard determinism, libertarianism, compatibilism, Frankfurt cases, Libet experiments

lessons.title: The Extended and Embodied Mind
lessons.focus: Clark and Chalmers' Otto's notebook, enactivism, smartphones as mind extensions

lessons.title: Consciousness at the Frontier: Panpsychism and Illusionism
lessons.focus: Russellian monism, combination problem, Dennett and Frankish's illusionism, integrated information theory

tracks.title: Political and Social Philosophy
tracks.description: Power, legitimacy, community and justice in depth.

lessons.title: Political Legitimacy and Authority
lessons.focus: Why obey the state? Consent, fair play, anarchism (Wolff), Weber on legitimacy

lessons.title: Liberalism and Its Communitarian Critics
lessons.focus: Sandel's unencumbered self, Taylor, Walzer, MacIntyre vs Rawls

lessons.title: Democracy: Deliberation, Epistocracy and Its Discontents
lessons.focus: Deliberative democracy (Habermas), Brennan's epistocracy, Condorcet jury theorem, public reason

lessons.title: Freedom: Negative, Positive and Republican
lessons.focus: Isaiah Berlin's two concepts, Pettit's freedom as non-domination, markets and freedom

lessons.title: Global Justice and Cosmopolitanism
lessons.focus: Borders and immigration ethics, Pogge on global poverty, nationalism vs cosmopolitanism, Nussbaum's capabilities approach

tracks.title: Philosophy Beyond the West
tracks.description: Great traditions of India, China, Africa and beyond.

lessons.title: Confucianism: Ritual, Virtue and Relationships
lessons.focus: Confucius, ren and li, junzi, Mencius vs Xunzi on human nature, filial piety

lessons.title: Daoism: The Way and Effortless Action
lessons.focus: Laozi, Dao De Jing, wu wei, Zhuangzi's butterfly dream, relativism and spontaneity

lessons.title: Buddhist Philosophy: No-Self and Emptiness
lessons.focus: Four Noble Truths, anatta, dependent origination, Nagarjuna's emptiness, comparison with Hume

lessons.title: Indian Philosophy: Vedanta and Nyaya Logic
lessons.focus: Upanishads, Atman and Brahman, Shankara's Advaita, Nyaya epistemology and inference, Carvaka materialism

lessons.title: African and Latin American Philosophy
lessons.focus: Ubuntu, Kwasi Wiredu, Oruka's sage philosophy, Aztec philosophy (Maffie), liberation philosophy (Dussel)

tracks.title: Knowledge, Science and Reality
tracks.description: Advanced epistemology and the philosophy of science and mathematics.

lessons.title: Radical Skepticism: Brains in Vats
lessons.focus: Putnam's brain in a vat, Moore's 'here is a hand', contextualism, simulation argument (Bostrom)

lessons.title: Bayesian Reasoning and Probability
lessons.focus: Bayes' theorem intuitively, base rate fallacy, priors, updating beliefs, Bayesian epistemology

lessons.title: Scientific Realism and Its Critics
lessons.focus: No-miracles argument, pessimistic meta-induction, van Fraassen's constructive empiricism, structural realism

lessons.title: Social Epistemology: Testimony, Experts and Echo Chambers
lessons.focus: Trusting testimony, expert disagreement, echo chambers vs epistemic bubbles (Nguyen), misinformation

lessons.title: Philosophy of Mathematics: Are Numbers Real?
lessons.focus: Platonism, formalism, intuitionism, indispensability argument, unreasonable effectiveness of mathematics
